Eye of the Ancestors: Everytime a friendly unit is removed from the game, place a Judgement token next to the enemy unit that caused the last wound. An enemy unit can't have more than 2 Judgement tokens at the same time. All friendly units attacking a target with at least 1 Judgement token gain the following, cumulative benefits:
Character models that join a unit pool their Judgement tokens together. Once they leave the unit, these tokens have to be split up evenly.
Steady Advance: The unit can never receive an "Advance" order and gains the "Move through cover" ability.
Void armor: Enemy attacks reduce their AT and AP value by -1, to a minimum of 0 each.
